idea-plugin.name: nox
idea-plugin.description:
Surfaces nox security findings inline in JetBrains IDEs — squiggly underlines on the offending line, hover for the rule and message, and entries in the Problems view.

Deterministic and offline. It runs the local nox binary over the nox lsp language server (JSON-RPC over stdio); no code leaves your machine and no model is called. On open and save the server scans that file and publishes diagnostics.

Requires the nox binary on your PATH (brew install nox), or set the NOX_PATH environment variable.
